data.narrative:
Humans& is an AI & Software company at an undisclosed stage, founded by Eric Zelikman, Georges Harik, Noah Goodman, Andi Peng, and Yuchen He. The broader AI & Software sector contains 12 identified peers, comprising 1 public company (Palantir, ticker PLTR) and 8 private firms including Figure AI, Scale AI, Reflection AI, and Applied Intuition.

A peer-median valuation approach is not applicable here. Despite identifying 12 same-sector companies, none satisfied the filtering criteria necessary for robust triangulation: zero companies matched on stage, zero on adjacent stage, and zero on similar valuation tier. Establishing a meaningful peer set requires a minimum of three comparable datapoints; applying an all-sector median would introduce substantial error given the wide dispersion of stage, scale, and business model across the broader AI & Software universe. The single public comp (Palantir) operates at a different scale and maturity profile than an early-stage frontier-tech player.

Without sufficient stage-matched or tier-matched peers, standard DCF, revenue multiple, or comparable company methodologies cannot be reliably deployed. A defensible valuation for Humans& would require either: acquisition of narrower peer financials at matching stages, direct revenue or growth-rate data from the target, or deployment of venture-specific methods (e.g., probability-weighted outcomes or seed/Series multiples) if funding round details become available. The current data set does not support a quantitative range.
